```{r} 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

source("feature_engineering_functions.R")

X13_14 <- read.csv("Data/13_14.csv")
X14_15 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/14_15.csv")
X15_16 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/15_16.csv")
X16_17 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/16_17.csv")
X17_18 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/17_18.csv")
X18_19 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/18_19.csv")
X19_20 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/19_20.csv")
X20_21 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/20_21.csv")
X21_22 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/21_22.csv")
X22_23 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/22_23.csv")
X23_24 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/23_24.csv")
X24_25 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/24_25.csv")
X25_26 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/25_26.csv")

get_valid_preds <- function(training_data, poisson_formula) {
  seasons <- training_data %>%
    distinct(Year) %>%
    mutate(s = as.integer(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
    arrange(s) %>%
    pull(Year)

  map_dfr(seasons[-1], function(sn) {
    tr <- training_data %>%
      filter(Year %in% seasons[seq_len(match(sn, seasons) - 1)])
    va <- training_data %>%
      filter(Year == sn)

    m <- glm(poisson_formula, data = tr, family = poisson(link = "log"))

    va %>% mutate(predicted_goals = predict(m, va, type = "response"))
  })
}

season_data_training <- list(
  "2014/15" = X14_15, "2015/16" = X15_16, "2016/17" = X16_17,
  "2017/18" = X17_18, "2018/19" = X18_19, "2019/20" = X19_20,
  "2020/21" = X20_21, "2021/22" = X21_22, "2022/23" = X22_23,
  "2023/24" = X23_24
)
training_prev <- list(X13_14, X14_15, X15_16, X16_17, X17_18,
                      X18_19, X19_20, X20_21, X21_22, X22_23)

# Validation: 2024/25 (previous season 2023/24)
validation_data  <- X24_25
validation_prev  <- X23_24
validation_label <- "2024/25"

predictors <- c(
  "HomeAway", "TeamRankCategory", "OpponentRankCategory",
  "Round", "OpponentRound", "RestAdvantage",
  "DWF", "DLF", "DDF",
  "attack_score", "defence_score",
  "opp_attack_score", "opp_defence_score",
  "DRF", "DYF", "DFF", "DCS", "DSTF", "DSF"
)

alpha_grid <- seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.05)
beta_grid  <- seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.01)

# ---- Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
poisson_deviance <- function(y, mu) {
  2 * mean(ifelse(y == 0, 0, y * log(y / mu)) - (y - mu))
}

# Turn per-team predicted goals into predicted/actual league tables
season_table <- function(df, beta) {
  mp <- df %>%
    select(match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = HomeAway,
                values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)) %>%
    mutate(
      gd       = predicted_goals_Home - predicted_goals_Away,
      pred_res = case_when(abs(gd) <= beta ~ "D", gd > beta ~ "H", TRUE ~ "A"),
      act_res  = case_when(Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
                           Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A", TRUE ~ "D")
    )

  pts <- function(res, side) case_when(res == side ~ 3, res == "D" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)

  tab <- bind_rows(
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Home,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "H"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "H"),
                     pred_gd = gd, act_gd = Goals_Home - Goals_Away,
                     act_gf = Goals_Home),
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Away,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "A"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "A"),
                     pred_gd = -gd, act_gd = Goals_Away - Goals_Home,
                     act_gf = Goals_Away)
  ) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(pred_pts), desc(pred_gd), Team) %>%        
    mutate(pred_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(desc(act_pts), desc(act_gd), desc(act_gf), Team) %>%  
    mutate(act_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(Team)

  list(tab = tab, mp = mp)
}

# ---- One alpha, start to finish -----------------------------------------
run_alpha <- function(alpha) {

  # 1. Build training data with this alpha
  training_data <- map_dfr(seq_along(season_data_training), function(i) {
    build_season_dataset(
      current_data  = season_data_training[[i]],
      previous_data = training_prev[[i]],
      season_label  = names(season_data_training)[i],
      alpha         = alpha
    )
  })

  # 2. Variable selection for this alpha
  model_data <- training_data %>% select(Goals, all_of(predictors)) %>% na.omit()
  null_model <- glm(Goals ~ 1, data = model_data,
                    family = stats::poisson(link = "log"))
  full_model <- glm(reformulate(predictors, response = "Goals"),
                    data = model_data,
                    family = stats::poisson(link = "log"))
  sel_model <- step(null_model,
                    scope = list(lower = formula(null_model),
                                 upper = formula(full_model)),
                    direction = "both", trace = 0)
  poisson_formula <- formula(sel_model)

  # 3. Choose beta by matching H/D/A proportions (expanding window, training only)
  valid_preds <- get_valid_preds(training_data, poisson_formula)

  # Target proportions over the SAME seasons the predictions cover
  actual_props <- training_data %>%
    filter(Year %in% unique(valid_preds$Year)) %>%
    select(match_id, HomeAway, Goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = HomeAway, values_from = Goals) %>%
    summarise(H = mean(Home > Away), D = mean(Home == Away), A = mean(Home < Away))

  gd_data <- valid_preds %>%
    select(match_id, HomeAway, predicted_goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = HomeAway, values_from = predicted_goals) %>%
    mutate(gd = Home - Away)

  prop_sweep <- map_dfr(beta_grid, function(b) {
    tibble(Beta = b,
           pred_H = mean(gd_data$gd >  b),
           pred_D = mean(abs(gd_data$gd) <= b),
           pred_A = mean(gd_data$gd < -b))
  }) %>%
    mutate(dist = (pred_H - actual_props$H)^2 +
                  (pred_D - actual_props$D)^2 +
                  (pred_A - actual_props$A)^2)

  beta_chosen <- prop_sweep %>% slice_min(dist, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(Beta)

  # 4. Build 2024/25 with the same alpha, fit on ALL training seasons, predict
  validation_df <- build_season_dataset(
    current_data  = validation_data,
    previous_data = validation_prev,
    season_label  = validation_label,
    alpha         = alpha
  )

  final_model <- glm(poisson_formula, data = training_data,
                     family = poisson(link = "log"))
  validation_df <- validation_df %>%
    mutate(predicted_goals = predict(final_model, newdata = validation_df,
                                     type = "response"))

  # 5. Score
  st <- season_table(validation_df, beta_chosen)

  tibble(
    alpha       = alpha,
    beta        = beta_chosen,
    rank_mse    = mean((st$tab$pred_rank - st$tab$act_rank)^2),
    spearman    = cor(st$tab$pred_rank, st$tab$act_rank, method = "spearman"),
    deviance    = poisson_deviance(validation_df$Goals, validation_df$predicted_goals),
    pred_draw   = mean(st$mp$pred_res == "D"),
    formula     = paste(deparse(poisson_formula, width.cutoff = 500), collapse = "")
  )
}

# ---- Run over all alphas -------------------------------------------------
alpha_results <- map_dfr(alpha_grid, run_alpha)

alpha_results %>% select(-formula) %>% arrange(rank_mse)

ggplot(alpha_results, aes(alpha, deviance)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(y = "Deviance (2024/25)")
ggplot(alpha_results, aes(alpha, rank_mse)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(y = "Mean squared rank error (2024/25)")
ggplot(alpha_results, aes(alpha, spearman)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(y = "Spearman (2024/25)")
```

keep_cols <- names(X14_15)[1:23]

                "X19_20", "X20_21", "X21_22", "X22_23", "X23_24", "X24_25")

  assign(nm, get(nm)[, keep_cols])
}

  X18_19,
  X19_20,
  X20_21,
  X21_22,

)

training_datasets <- lapply(
  seq_along(season_data),
  function(i) {
    build_season_dataset(
      current_data = season_data[[i]],
      previous_data = previous_data[[i]],
      season_label = names(season_data)[i],
      0.15)

)
